title: Hinomori Shiho — With Some Embarrassment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I figured that there'd be a lot of people here for New Year's...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But this crowd's huge.
Even if we line up now, it might be a long time before we get to make our wishes at the shrine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, the lines for charms and fortunes don't seem very long. Why don't we make a quick stop there first?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh oh! Wait a second!
What if the deities get overloaded with wishes?! Are they still gonna have enough power left for us...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be fine since they're probably used to hearing everyone's wishes each year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I didn't know you two would be here! Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The clothes you're wearing... Did you both run here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Haruka said she wanted to get in some exercise by jogging to the shrine, so I decided to join her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we saw more people than we expected when we went to make our wishes... Which is why we decided to line up for fortunes instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then, wanna join us?
We were just thinking the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
There's a reason for that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A great blessing!!! I got a great blessing, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right! Congratulations, Honami, that's amazing!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You tried really hard that time when we worked as shrine maidens. The deities probably noticed and decided to reward you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm! This red bean dango soup's so good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They usually serve amazake. I've never seen them serve anything like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me neither.
And this sign says, “Happy Birdie Red Bean Soup”... What do you think that means?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This dango's shaped like a bird's face...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that...
I have one shaped like a bird's face too...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's an explanation written over there! Let's see... “If you find a birdie dango in your soup, then it's your lucky day! Eat it and your luck for the year is guaranteed to be great!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow!
That explains why it's called “Happy Birdie Red Bean Soup”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, Haruka, that means your luck for this year's gonna be amazing if you eat it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go make our wishes!
We shouldn't have to wait as long now since the line seems to have thinned out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm ready to make lots and lots of wishes♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you already know what you're going to wish for, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?
Are you having trouble choosing just one?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just feel that I should be trying to make my own wishes come true instead of asking any deities for their help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I'm not really sure what to say...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you make a declaration instead?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Apparently, you don't necessarily have to make a wish. You can also tell the deities that you're going to try to accomplish something.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I think it's a nice opportunity to tell them about your plans for the future.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...!
I always just end up wishing for a lot of different stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. There's nothing wrong with that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that stating your plans for the future suits you a little better, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I might feel a little more comfortable doing that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kiritani...
I think I can figure out what I wanna say now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm going to make the music that I want to as a pro.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our music's gonna move people's hearts. It's gonna give people the power to keep moving forward...)
